dedupe_keys.name: destination labels for battery electric vehicles in evmt dataset

description: Destination labels for battery electric vehicles in eVMT dataset is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset provides detailed information on the destination labels for the trip trajectory and charging of 65 Battery Electric Vehicles in California in the eVMT dataset. This dataset includes the Tesla Model S and Chevrolet Bolt only. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are electric vehicles, transportation, vehicle trips, travel. The portal shows 2024-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
